reports.email_summary: Strategy files detailed proxy for daily preferred dividends; no new BTC buys, holdings steady at 846,000 BTC.
reports.bottom_line: The only new capital-markets action this window is a governance/mechanics change (daily dividend record dates for preferred stock) that leaves total payout and BTC per share unaffected. No new bitcoin purchases, sales, or dilutive issuance were disclosed in the last three days, so the treasury/BTC-per-share thesis is unchanged.

updates.headline: Board files proxy for daily preferred-dividend record dates
updates.what_happened: Strategy's board approved putting proposed amendments to the certificates of designation for STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD to a shareholder vote, moving all four preferred series to daily dividend record dates with payment the next business day. A preliminary proxy (PRE 14A) was filed September 25 for an October 28, 2026 virtual special meeting, with September 25 set as the voting record date; first daily-schedule payments are expected November 2, 2026 for STRC and January 4, 2027 for STRF/STRK/STRD.
updates.thesis_fit: Improves preferred-stock trading mechanics and could reduce STRC's swings around record dates, supporting the credit stack's stability, but it does not change dividend rates, total payout obligations, or BTC per share.

updates.headline: Strategy launches shareholder campaign backing dividend vote
updates.what_happened: Strategy filed Rule 14a-12 soliciting material launching a shareholder-outreach campaign (dedicated voting site, investor presentation, social media push) supporting the daily-dividend proposal. Only common shareholders as of the September 25 record date may vote, and passage requires a majority of total common voting power, with Saylor controlling roughly 32.9% via Class B shares.
updates.thesis_fit: A governance/capital-structure mechanics change aimed at strengthening demand for the preferred 'digital credit' stack rather than a BTC accumulation or dilution event.

updates.headline: Saylor pitches 'digital asset bill of rights' policy framework
updates.what_happened: Michael Saylor shared an essay on X over the weekend and discussed a proposed 'bill of digital rights' for crypto participants at the Bitcoin Policy Institute's Freedom Tech DC event, arguing the reforms could help catalyze a much larger digital-asset industry.
updates.thesis_fit: Continued Saylor advocacy for favorable crypto policy is directionally supportive of the sector but is not a company-specific financing or treasury action affecting BTC per share.

reports.name: Metaplanet
reports.email_summary: No new material Metaplanet disclosures in the last 3 days; stock rallied with broader crypto market.
reports.bottom_line: No fresh filings, financing actions, or shareholder changes emerged in the September 24–27 window beyond already-reported items; the stock's ~18% bounce appears tied to a broader Bitcoin market rally rather than company-specific news. Thesis stance is unchanged pending the next quarterly BTC purchase disclosure or EDINET large-holder filing.
source_conflicts: mNAV figures vary by source and date: bitcointreasuries.net shows both 0.77x (EV basis) and 0.57x (basic) for the same 43,000 BTC holding, with page timestamps inconsistently dated Jul 2, 2026 and Sep 21, 2026 — treat current mNAV as indicative only.

Share price references conflict across sources for the same period: Investing.com shows 243 JPY as of Sep 23, while JinaCoin technical analysis shows 288 JPY as of Sep 25 following an 18.5% two-day rally.
